note: Hand-transcribed from the printed spell headers and text of SRD 5.2.1, 'Spell Descriptions', pp. 107-175 (these 25 spells are on pp. 110-173); never generated from content/data. Page is the printed page of the spell heading. Components, castingTime, range and duration are as printed. Phrases are verbatim runs of the description. Greater Restoration also carries its bullet list; Summon Dragon also carries the Draconic Spirit stat block, p. 166.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of bat fur)
phrases: You create an Invisible, invulnerable eye within range that hovers for the duration
It also has Darkvision with a range of 30 feet
As a Bonus Action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction
an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter

spells.name: Aura of Life
phrases: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration
you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage
Hit Point maximums can’t be reduced
that ally regains 1 Hit Point

spells.name: Blight
phrases: taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
A Plant creature automatically fails the save
target a nonmagical plant that isn’t a creature, such as a tree or shrub
it simply withers and dies
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4

spells.name: Charm Monster
phrases: It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it
the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it
The Charmed creature is Friendly to you
the target knows it was Charmed by you
spells.scalingPhrase: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4

spells.name: Commune
phrases: You contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no
You receive a correct answer for each question
you might receive “unclear” as an answer
a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.components: V, S, M (a small crystal or glass cone)
phrases: You unleash a blast of cold air
Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
phrases: the spirit of a long-dead sage
make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw
you can ask the entity up to five questions
“irrelevant,” or “unclear”
you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the Incapacitated condition until you finish a Long Rest
A Greater Restoration spell cast on you ends this effect

spells.name: Death Ward
phrases: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death
the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends
an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or a firefly)
phrases: Wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration
shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet
The warm shield grants you Resistance to Cold damage, and the chill shield grants you Resistance to Fire damage
The attacker takes 2d8 Fire damage from a warm shield or 2d8 Cold damage from a chill shield

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur)
phrases: A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above
a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder
taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
spells.scalingPhrase: The Fire damage and the Radiant damage increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
phrases: You touch a willing creature
the target’s movement is unaffected by Difficult Terrain
nor cause the target to have the Paralyzed or Restrained conditions
The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed
the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints
spells.scalingPhrase: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4

spells.name: Geas
phrases: You give a verbal command to a creature that you can see within range
The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration
the creature takes 5d10 Psychic damage if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command
It takes this damage no more than once each day
Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends
A Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish spell ends this spell
spells.scalingPhrase: If you use a level 7 or 8 spell slot, the duration is 365 days. If you use a level 9 spell slot, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
phrases: You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:
bullets: A curse, including the target’s Attunement to a cursed magic item
Any reduction to one of the target’s ability scores
Any reduction to the target’s Hit Point maximum

spells.name: Guardian of Faith
phrases: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration
The guardian occupies that space and is invulnerable
taking 20 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage

spells.name: Ice Storm
phrases: Hail falls in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder
A creature takes 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
Hailstones turn ground in the Cylinder into Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn
spells.scalingPhrase: The Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4

spells.name: Insect Plague
phrases: Swarming locusts fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere
its area is Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain
taking 4d10 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
A creature makes this save only once per turn
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 5

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.components: V, S, M (incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each)
phrases: Name or describe a famous person, place, or object
a brief summary of the significant lore about that famous thing
couched in figurative language or poetry
you hear sad musical notes played on a trombone, and the spell fails

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
phrases: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see within range
Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point
Each target regains Hit Points equal to 5d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier
spells.scalingPhrase: The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5

spells.name: Polymorph
phrases: You attempt to transform a creature that you can see within range into a Beast
shape-shift into a Beast form for the duration
See the “Animals” section of “Monsters” for a sample of Beast stat blocks
The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the Beast form
it can’t speak or cast spells
The target’s gear melds into the new form

spells.name: Power Word Heal
phrases: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range
The target regains all its Hit Points
If the creature has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, the condition ends
it can use its Reaction to stand up

spells.name: Power Word Kill
phrases: You compel one creature you can see within range to die
If the target has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies
Otherwise, it takes 12d12 Psychic damage

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.components: V, S, M (an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it worth 500+ GP)
phrases: You call forth a Dragon spirit
uses the Draconic Spirit stat block
In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours
it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger
Draconic Spirit
Breath Weapon. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot Cone.
statBlock: HP 50 + 10 for each spell level above 5
Speed 30 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 30 ft.
MOD SAVE MOD SAVE MOD SAVE
Resistances Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison
Senses Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 12
Languages Draconic, understands the languages you know
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Shared Resistances. When you summon the spirit, choose one of its Resistances. You have Resistance to the chosen damage type until the spell ends.
Multiattack. The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell’s level (round down), and it uses Breath Weapon.
Rend. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 feet. Hit: 1d6 + 4 + the spell’s level Piercing damage.

Breath Weapon. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 2d6 damage of a type this spirit has Resistance to (your choice when you cast the spell). Success: Half damage.
spells.scalingPhrase: Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block

spells.name: Tree Stride
phrases: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet
You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree
You can use this transportation ability only once on each of your turns
You must end each turn outside a tree

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.components: V, S, M (a piece of charcoal)
phrases: You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick
The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration
taking 5d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
The other side of the wall deals no damage
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.components: V, S, M (a cube of granite)
phrases: A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range
composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels
10-foot-by-20-foot panels that are only 3 inches thick
You can crudely shape the wall to create battlements and the like
Each panel has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points per inch of thickness
the wall becomes permanent and can’t be dispelled
